description.narrative: The ABADEI strategy represents one of the first large-scale attempts to operationalize a basic human needs approach (approach of essential support to basic services, livelihoods and community resilience) within the complex and fast evolving context of Afghanistan. Conceptually, it provides an articulation of investments in basic services, livelihoods and community resilience that complement humanitarian efforts by helping households, communities, and the private sector cope with the adverse effects of the crisis.
